title: Artifact received from recovery team
treatment: Logged a copper-alloy fitting into the conservation register following controlled recovery. The object remained in its recovery container pending transfer to the wet room.
materials: Recovery container RC-04-118; temporary object tag NS04-F17
notes: Provenance and transfer documentation checked at receipt. No dry storage or surface cleaning performed.

title: Initial condition survey
treatment: Completed a visual survey while the fitting remained wet. Recorded visible marine growth, surface deposits, and areas requiring closer observation.
materials: Object tray WT-12; photo scale; condition record NS04-F17
notes: Baseline photographs filed under NS04-F17. Corrosion products were left undisturbed during documentation.

title: Monitoring plan approved
treatment: Established a supervised monitoring schedule for the fitting and linked its observations to the object record.
materials: Monitoring sheet MS-04; sealed sample labels
notes: Next review scheduled with the conservation team. Any change in appearance will be documented before further treatment is considered.
